verdict.rationale: Expensify's own docs say admins can "configure workspaces, build rules" via its AI assistant and approve or reject expenses, and the product offers "Smart Limits" on cards. That is a thin first-party sign of policy-rule capability, but nothing shows how deep those rules go. Missing for 10: documented per-category, per-role or context-based expense limits, automatic approval of in-policy expenses with only exceptions routed to a human, details of the approval workflow, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
